reserveReview.rationale: Current-block refresh on 2026-08-29: at Ethereum block 25,862,798 (timestamp 2026-08-29T18:47:35Z), the pmUSD Treasury (0x51c4348af0c6066a2fd31bd968bc0c039fe27342) returned TokenBlender (0x7a7f847fb60b0000e24cce07298dc73df8b8e56a) from baseToken(). The verified TokenBlender implementation exposes one supported token; getSupportedTokens() returned only ION.au (0xd051c326c9aef673428e6f01eb65d2c52de95d30). At the same pinned block, Treasury balanceOf(TokenBlender) returned 26,528.7852 TB (matching the current Etherscan and RAAC display rounded to 26,528.79), while getTokenReserveBalance(ION.au) and TokenBlender totalSupply each returned 26,531.98 units. The Treasury's TB holding is therefore an ION.au-backed position; the small difference from aggregate TB supply does not identify another supported token. The direct pmUSD reserve path remains a single 100% TokenBlender position backed solely by ION.au. RAAC identifies ION.au as the pmUSD collateral and the Chainlink feed is corroborative for I-ON's broader reserve, but neither source resolves the legal enforceability, valuation, extraction costs, or recovery liquidity of the underlying in-situ gold claims.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: pmUSD collateral is the TokenBlender base token held in RAAC's on-chain RWf(x) Treasury, minted against ION.au in-situ gold claims. The reviewed sources do not establish how ION.au gold claims are custodied or perfected, whether claim assets are segregated from I-ON Digital's estate, or any reuse terms; the Chainlink ION proof-of-reserve feed attests existence, not legal custody terms.
